# 7440 - Dual 4-input NAND buffer

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7440.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7440.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 11 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7440 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7440.png) | ![7440 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand-buf4.png) | ![7440 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand-buf4.png) |

A tall empty box with a long point on the right, four inputs.

How to tell it on a drawing: Four-input NAND buffer.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |
| 3 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 4 | 1C | input |  |  |
| 5 | 1D | input |  |  |
| 6 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 8 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 10 | 2B | input |  |  |
| 11 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 12 | 2C | input |  |  |
| 13 | 2D | input |  |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 1Y = NOT (1A AND 1B AND 1C AND 1D) | 1Y is low only when all four inputs 1A-1D are high. |
| 8 | 2Y = NOT (2A AND 2B AND 2C AND 2D) | 2Y is low only when all four inputs 2A-2D are high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1.2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Buffer: IOL 48 mA, three times the 16 mA of a standard 74 gate. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 133 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/05.pdf) - 5-14 (PDF page 14); SN7440 (J, N package)
